messages:
pagerbot: 🔔 AUTO-PAGER fired — high http 5xx rate detected from inference-gateway-usw2: error_rate > 8% for 2m. Alerting SRE rotation. Rule: gateway.errors.5xx > 5%
jen_sre: acked. looking now. any customer impact flags? :eyes:
maria: seeing rapid increase in 502/504 from edge-proxy -> inference-gateway. spikes line up with a deploy ~6m ago. logs show backend timeouts, lots of `upstream reset`
devon: @maria can you paste the deploy id? I want to check canary routing and autoscale metrics
maria: deploy-bot: deployment `edge-release/2026-03-15T01:12Z` rolled to 100% in us-west2 at +00:06. here are tail logs from gateway:
```
2026-03-15T01:16:02Z ERROR inference-gateway us-west2 upstream reset id=abc123 conn=reset status=502 latency=120ms
2026-03-15T01:16:07Z WARN  edge-proxy  connection timeout to backend id=abc124 status=504
2026-03-15T01:16:20Z ERROR inference-gateway kvcache miss + spike of queued requests
```
maria: also seeing KV cache evictions around same time, might be memory pressure on sidecars
jen_sre: good catch. I'm going to temporarily open the fallback route to eu-west1 to reduce customer impact. devon, can you scale gateway-workers in us-west2 to +50% and disable keepalive pooling for 10m?
devon: scaling replicas now: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=12 -n prod-usw2` — applying. disabling keepalive in runtime config now: `kubectl patch cm gateway-config -p '{"data":{"keepalive":"off-temp"}}'`
deploy-bot: deployment edge-release/2026-03-15T01:12Z — no rollback in progress
pagerbot: page acknowledged by jen_sre, escalation paused.
jen_sre: initiating traffic reroute: adding a weighted route split 70% eu-west1, 30% us-west2 via routing API. link: https://console.internal/routing/edgesplit?id=route-273
sam_pm: looping in product/customer ops — preparing a short note for any affected customers. Recommend telling customers latency/backoff and mitigation in 30m.
maria: infra updates: memory on sidecars peaked, kube OOM events at 01:15:55. I think the edge change increased request fanout to local caches and triggered eviction cascade.
jen_sre: applying circuit breaker on backend pool to fail fast and reduce retries: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/circuit -d '{"pool":"inference-backends","threshold":0.05}'`
devon: circuit posted. verifying metrics... error-rate downtrend but latencies still elevated. scaling completed, keepalive off.
jen_sre: reroute in effect, rolling window shows 5xx rate falling from 9% -> 2.1% over 3m. good. removing immediate alerting noise: `pagerbot silence gateway.errors.5xx 15m`
pagerbot: command accepted — rule gateway.errors.5xx silenced for 15m by jen_sre.
alex_oncall: taking follow-up for next hour to watch for regression. leaving notes in incident doc: https://wiki.internal/incidents/1734567890
sam_pm: drafted customer-impact note: short blurb + link to status page. no major customer-reported failures yet, a few increased latencies. sending to comms for approval.
jen_sre: plan: keep reroute for 20m, monitor kvcache metrics, revert keepalive once memory stabilizes. if 5xx > 4% re-open page and rollback deploy. any objections?
emojis: :thumbsup: from devon, maria
maria: will follow up with heap/profile from sidecars and open a ticket for improving cache eviction behavior under fanout.
jen_sre: thanks team — handing off now to alex_oncall for watch. marking initial mitigation as successful, will file full postmortem if we need deeper root cause. closing thread for now but keep channel open for updates.
